description: Approved application UI terminology. Protects labels from accidental replacement. Does NOT freeze dynamic report content. This is a source-string contract — NOT a visual test.

terms.label: Review / Edit Project & Report Details
terms.notes: Workbench action back to the pre-flight screen — says the details already exist and may be amended.

terms.label: Today’s Site Diary
terms.notes: Section divider marking where persistent project/report details end and today's diary content begins. Rendered uppercase.

terms.label: View Saved Diaries
terms.notes: Second of exactly two equal Site Diary hub cards, beside Start a New Diary.

terms.label: Tap a diary to open and review it.
terms.notes: Exact helper copy on the Saved Diaries browsing list. Do not expand.

terms.label: Share Report
terms.notes: Opened saved-diary review primary action. User goal is sharing; PDF generation stays behind the scenes. PrimaryCTA surface=workbench (restrained rust perimeter, not landing powder-coat).

terms.label: Use as Basis for New Diary
terms.notes: Creates a new diary ID from the opened saved diary. Source diary is never modified.

terms.label: Back
terms.notes: ZlogBackControl visible label — not every occurrence of the English word.

terms.label: Delete Diary
terms.notes: Count-aware helper returns Delete Diary for one saved diary. Viewer and project recent list use this label. Saved Diaries browsing rows do not offer Delete.

terms.label: Saving your work…
terms.notes: Unobtrusive in-progress autosave status. The workbench renders this via autosaveStatusMessage(). Not the Save / Share button.

terms.label: Work saved
terms.notes: Shown only after a successful content UPDATE. Must not imply the diary is finished or shared.

terms.label: Work not saved. Check your connection.
terms.notes: Autosave network/offline failure only. Database, auth, and conflict failures use distinct copy.

terms.label: Work not saved. Try again in a moment.
terms.notes: Autosave database/update failure — not a connection message.

terms.label: Your sign-in has timed out. Sign in again to keep editing.
Updated from your last saved copy.
terms.notes: Stale-write protection restored server content into the form.
